name: WearTryOn
tagline: WearTryOn – Lay a new garment over the photo you bring
description: WearTryOn drapes a garment or a full outfit of up to three pieces on your photo while face, hair, pose, and background stay in place. Sample previews with Ava and Leo need no sign in. Welcome credits start at ten, and check-in adds two more each day. Plus costs 11 dollars a month and grants 1,500 credits. Pro costs 23 dollars a month, grants 5,000 credits, and allows commercial use. Packs start at 6 dollars once and never expire. Watermarks may appear on free or unsigned results, and any purchase clears them.
